name: pivotscope-web
comment_overrides: monaco-editor 0.56 pulls in dompurify 3.4.8, which is affected by three advisories (<=3.4.11). npm audit fix --force would downgrade Monaco to 0.53, which would break the exports map used by monaco-core. We force the transitive dependency to the patched version. Reassess when monaco upgrades it itself.
